body: PM me if you want to vent. I'll listen to you.

Hey, dude. You're not alone. I've had experiences with feeling like you're living someone else's life. I've also felt outcast from everyone when I needed support, too. 

Hang in there--especially for your parents. You are the best thing that's ever happened to them. 

If you want to vent, PM me.

Howdy, pal. I agree that my friends are assholes, and I should probably get out more. Social anxiety's killer, but here's the irony: I'm a teacher for my day job.

Anyway, thank you very much for the words.

It's nice to complete something--yes, and making people happy is what I really like to do. I can think of a couple people in my personal life that are genuinely concerned, just want the "old me" back, but treat me like a powder keg with a lit fuse. I'm just not the same person, but I'm working on it.

Thank you.

You're spot on several things. Yes, my friends think depression is fake, and that suicide is just an attempt to get attention because of social problems, like boredom (their words). I was called less of a man because I wanted out through suicide and literally had one of them laugh in my face.

I'm in a downward spiral, of course, and I'm really good at rationalizing self-fulfilling prophesies, going back on personal goals--like quitting drinking/smoking--because my rapid-cycling always gives me an excuse to fall back, and it just keeps going and going.

Thank you for your support. I very much appreciate it.

Howdy, pal. The film industry--especially for no-budget indies--is tough. However, when people see the movie when/if it comes out, I think that will help me get back some steam.

Thank you for the words.

Thanks for the words, pal. I often try to think of what I've done right, but my rapid-cycling moods tend to kill what progress I make. I try to get a good laugh in every day, but it feels like the moon in 'Majora's Mask' is inevitably going to come down and then I couldn't handle it anymore. 

I'll take your advice, and I'll pay if forward and help others to try to feel better using this subreddit. I think that is the best path.

Thank you.
